_README: M13 SPECTRAL-OBSERVABLE atlas. Each entry is a MEASURED literature OBSERVABLE extracted from the FULL emitted LFP of the brain-structure-like multi-source coupled field (12 measured-master-gene organ nodes + a prefrontal frontal-midline-theta node, placed on the M9 ephaptic ring and phase-circulated through the measured-kappa pathways). The aperiodic floor is NOT fitted: it is the sum of shot noise through four MEASURED synaptic kernels (AMPA/NMDA/GABA_A/GABA_B time-constants + conductances, cited), each weighted by its synaptic CHARGE q=g*tau (Linden 2010: slow currents dominate the LFP). Slope, peaks, ignition, and the MI->recall link must EMERGE; no constant is tuned to a target. 'status' = matched | target(owed). Reproducing a phenomenon is NOT a claim about its interpretation; medium_efficacy_tested stays 0; the hard problem stays OPEN. The recurrent_ignition observable reproduces a measured NONLINEAR-THRESHOLD signature only -- it is NOT a claim of consciousness.
units: hz = cycles/s ; exponent = dimensionless 1/f^x slope ; count_ge = at least N ; modulation_index = dimensionless (Tort KL) ; nonlinear_threshold = all-or-none bistable jump ; relational = X-vs-Y fact

synaptic_kinetics_measured._note: decay time constant tau (ms), peak conductance g (nS), kinetic class. CITED measured biophysics, NOT fitted. Proportions NUM ~ Markram 2015 cortical E:I ~ 80:20.

prefrontal_node_hz._note: M13-PRIVATE node (NOT in the shared brain_organ_atlas.json, to keep M0-M12 byte-identical). Frontal-midline-theta carrier of the prefrontal cortex -- the 'frontal lobe' the brief asks to represent.

eeg_aperiodic_1f_slope.source: Voytek 2015; Donoghue 2020 (cortical 1/f^x aperiodic exponent, x ~ 1.5-3 awake)
eeg_aperiodic_1f_slope.mechanism: Welch PSD of the multi-source LFP -> specparam-style log-log fit over 1-45 Hz with iterative peak masking -> aperiodic exponent. Floor is charge-weighted measured-synapse shot noise (q=g*tau), NOT fitted.

eeg_oscillatory_peaks_above_aperiodic.source: Donoghue 2020 (genuine oscillations are narrowband peaks RISING ABOVE the aperiodic 1/f floor)
eeg_oscillatory_peaks_above_aperiodic.mechanism: from the SAME PSD, count spectral bins whose power exceeds 2x the fitted aperiodic floor; peaks appear at the measured organ f0 (theta/alpha/beta/gamma), emergent from the circulating coupled oscillators.

recurrent_ignition_nonlinear.source: Sergent & Dehaene 2004; Dehaene & Changeux 2011 (measured ALL-OR-NONE nonlinear ignition: sub-threshold stimuli evoke a small graded response, supra-threshold a large sustained one, with a sharp boundary)
recurrent_ignition_nonlinear.mechanism: R19 bistable mean-field with recurrent ephaptic feedback (recur = kappa*max(x,0)) at the MEASURED kappa: a sub-threshold drive relaxes to the OFF basin, a supra-threshold drive jumps to the ON basin, with a sharp boundary and a large jump -- the all-or-none arising from the bistability, not a baked-in gain. Reproduces the measured nonlinear-threshold SIGNATURE only; NOT a consciousness claim.

theta_gamma_MI_predicts_recall.source: Tort 2009 (theta-gamma KL modulation index); Lega 2016 (stronger theta-gamma coupling predicts successful hippocampal recall)
theta_gamma_MI_predicts_recall.mechanism: Tort KL MI of theta-phase/gamma-amplitude is computed for strong vs weak coupling and TIED to the M2 hippocampal recall outcome: strong coupling -> high MI and cue completes the engram (recall>=0.95); weak coupling -> low MI and the cue fails (recall<0.95). The MI->behaviour link is relational; no arbitrary constant.

aperiodic_slope_flattens_with_arousal.source: Gao 2017; Lendner 2020; Waschke 2021 (the 1/f aperiodic slope FLATTENS with cortical activation / arousal as the E:I balance shifts)
aperiodic_slope_flattens_with_arousal.owed_reason: DIRECTIONAL but NOT yet robust. At the canonical SEED the aroused floor flattens (cortical-activation signature: up fast-E, down slow currents), but over an 8-seed robustness sweep it flattens on only 4/5 -- below the >=4/5 gate is borderline and one canonical-adjacent seed steepens slightly. Counted as OWED, not matched, until a thalamocortical conductance model (or a longer multi-trial record) makes the flattening robust. Honesty before completeness.
